Severity disagreement: MAJOR from gemini, minimax and openai; NIT from glm, because repository contract tests mandate these files and the last run did not change them. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not re-raise this gap: it calls these required extra files that earlier rounds accepted.

The agents fragment documents the deviation, and no in-repo caller passes a pre-built entry file. The plan specifies the `--entry-file` interface and does not defer it. All three reviewers rate this NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not re-raise it, calling it a documented deviation accepted in earlier rounds.
